title: Linda Armas Tours · Catalog + stories
brief: Catalog as the protagonist, editorial storytelling below the travel cards, and personalized advice as a secondary action. Existing logo-inspired palette. Fictional content only; no production implementation. Original alternatives preserved. Motion inspired by infolavelada.com: soft screen entrances, progressive scroll reveals, and subtle illustration zoom. LAT palette retained; reduced-motion and unsupported-browser fallbacks included. Public site and staff preview separated. Light, dark and system appearance. Disabled illustrative login; no real authentication, credentials or client data.

artboards.title: Catalog first, stories alongside
artboards.tradeoff: Travel discovery comes first; editorial inspiration and tailored advice remain visible below the catalog. Longer homepage than the initial catalog direction. Restrained motion emphasizes discovery without scroll locking; scroll-linked reveals depend on browser support.

artboards.title: Staff access and workspace preview
artboards.tradeoff: Independent visual preview with disabled login. Preview navigation is intentionally unauthenticated and contains fictional data only; production must enforce server-side sessions and permissions.
